editorial.summary: A ten-second official-channel animation sketch whose two automatic-caption records contain eleven romanized-looking tokens that are not reliable English and cannot support a responsible translation. The archive preserves the raw tokens but does not pretend they form a verified Korean or other-language transcript, infer meaning from phonetic resemblance, or fabricate animation narration. The visual work, language, speaker and any character voice require audiovisual/native-language review. Zero named turns and zero enrollment windows ship.
